item.title: US life expectancy hit an all-time high in 2024, CDC says
item.description: U.S. life expectancy has hit the highest mark in American history. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Thursday reported that life expectancy rose to 79 years in 2024. It’s the result of the dissipation of the COVID-19 pandemic — and also waning death rates from all of the nation’s top killers, including heart disease, cancer and drug overdoses. item.title: Situation in US South grows more dire after days of ice, frigid temperatures and widespread outages
item.description: The situation for some of the most vulnerable people trapped in homes in Tennessee and Mississippi without electricity is reaching a breaking point. Officials say it could be days before power is restored across the South and more subfreezing temperatures are expected by Friday. The growing misery and anxiety comes amid what Mississippi officials say is the state’s worst winter storm in more than 30 years. item.title: EU appears poised to sanction Iran’s Revolutionary Guard over protest crackdown
